# Visual-layer binary fixtures

`sample_uastc_zstd.ktx2` is the Three.js KTX2 loader example texture. It is
used to prove that the pinned Basis runtime performs a real UASTC/Zstandard
transcode on each VIS-15a hardware target. Source:
`code4fukui/three.js_examples@main/textures/compressed/sample_uastc_zstd.ktx2`.
The upstream Three.js example repository is distributed under the MIT license.
